summary: Santander Holdings USA, Inc. filed an 8-K to report the completion of a public offer and sale of $2.5 billion aggregate principal amount of senior notes across three tranches: $1.0B 5.040% Fixed-to-Floating Senior Notes due 2030, $750M 5.220% Fixed-to-Floating Senior Notes due 2032, and $750M 5.701% Fixed-to-Floating Senior Notes due 2037. The notes were issued under an existing indenture and sold via underwriters led by Santander US Capital Markets LLC, BofA Securities, Citigroup, J.P. Morgan, Morgan Stanley, and RBC Capital Markets. This is a routine debt issuance, not a special situation, as it involves no change of control, shareholder return, or strategic event.
